name: SITUATIONAL_RACE_PATTERN_SHADOW
purpose: Classify each race by pre-race structure and test situation-specific prediction strategies without forcing every race into one prediction shape.

LOW_EVIDENCE.description: Many runners have little or no prior evidence; standard historical ranking is unreliable.
LOW_EVIDENCE.research_strategy: Reduce axis confidence, widen uncertainty handling, emphasize pedigree/training/new-horse modules when available, and prefer PASS until evidence quality improves.

DOMINANT_AXIS.description: One horse has strong durability, evidence and separation from the field.
DOMINANT_AXIS.research_strategy: Permit axis-centered structures while diversifying second/third-place roles.

FLAT_CHAOS.description: Top scores are compressed and uncertainty is high.
FLAT_CHAOS.research_strategy: Avoid forced single-axis prediction; use group survival, scenario diversity and stronger PASS/CAUTION control.

FRONT_PRESSURE.description: Escape/front styles are concentrated and pace pressure may invalidate simple ability order.
FRONT_PRESSURE.research_strategy: Increase pace-resilience and stalker/closer survival analysis; reduce confidence in mutually conflicting front-runners.

LOW_PACE_FRONT.description: Few obvious leaders are present and an uncontested forward position may persist.
LOW_PACE_FRONT.research_strategy: Increase position-taking and front/stalk persistence value while retaining ability guardrails.

THIRD_PLACE_VOLATILE.description: Several rank-5-to-10 runners have plausible intrusion signals.
THIRD_PLACE_VOLATILE.research_strategy: Expand third-place candidate diversity and test trio coverage changes without changing the shared horse-selection core for other wager types.

STABLE_TOP_CLUSTER.description: Several top-ranked horses have strong evidence and relatively low uncertainty.
STABLE_TOP_CLUSTER.research_strategy: Treat the top cluster as the main survival set; focus optimization on internal ordering and ticket conversion.

STANDARD.research_strategy: Use the production shared-selection core without situational override.

integration_governance.rule: A pattern-specific strategy remains shadow-only until repeated independent validation shows reproducible gains. Only the proven pattern-specific gene is integrated; losing pattern behavior stays on the general model.

leakage_policy: Pattern classification may use only information knowable before prediction sealing. Same-race odds, popularity, result and payout are forbidden.
